source.author: verg
source.text: Omne adeo genus in terris hominumque ferarumque, et genus aequoreum, pecudes pictaeque volucres, in furias.
source.text_original: Omne adeo genus in terris hominumque ferarumque, / et genus aequoreum, pecudes pictaeque volucres, / in furias.
source.text_english: So every kind on earth, both of men and of wild beasts, and the kind that dwells in the sea, cattle and painted birds, are driven into frenzy.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: item qui libidinum stimulis incitati, ut ait poeta, in furias ignemque ruunt, utique incredibilia nos afferre dicunt, quia uulnerant aures eorum praecepta continentiae, quae illos uoluptatibus suis prohibent quibus animam suam cum corpore adiudicauerunt .
reuse.text_original: item qui libidinum stimulis incitati, ut ait poeta, in furias ignemque ruunt, utique incredibilia nos afferre dicunt, quia uulnerant aures eorum praecepta continentiae, quae illos uoluptatibus suis prohibent quibus animam suam cum corpore adiudicauerunt .
reuse.text_english: Likewise, those who are stirred by the goads of lust and, as the poet says, rush into frenzy and fire, always say that we are bringing incredible things, because the precepts of self-restraint wound their ears, since these forbid those pleasures to which they have condemned their soul together with their body.
